verdict.rationale: Archived docs described scoped service tokens that could list and call tools only on connections matching specific metadata, plus namespace-scoped API keys. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, accounts and API keys stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that it remains only a public, non-proxied registry. The product therefore no longer ships a way to issue scoped credentials for agents, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
